# P8 learner validation on E-SYN

**ENGINEERING_ONLY.** Generated by `python -m paperc.learner_validation`.

## Benchmark design

The short budget world uses the P7 control's size and comparison law with 8 slots and 4 runs. Its baseline uses the frozen P4 N1 thresholds (static:0.001,-0.00103125). The best static Bayes-keep value, computed for this shorter horizon, is reported separately. A campaign-level mixture draws five P4 rungs crossed with ε ∈ {0, 0.1, 0.25}. N4 uses its frozen value law with a threshold table for this horizon.

Training roots [0, 4096] and support roots [4500, 5268] use disjoint half-open ranges. Dev [6000000, 6001200] and test [7000000, 7006000] use separate unrecorded root ranges. Each method has three fixed candidate settings and one screening fit per setting. Among supported candidates, choose the highest mean paired dev gain over N1, resolving ties in grid order. Refit the selected setting for 3 declared fit seeds in total and average their paired test gains per root. The paired Student interval describes test-root variation conditional on the fitted policies. Individual seed means are retained.

Every learner uses the same legal feature view, including runs, calls and proposal slots left. N6 adds training-only fork labels at uniform probability 0.75. It averages 4 rollouts per arm with a single frozen N1 continuation and fits unweighted per-epoch ridge regressions of total Q differences. R0 uses LightGBM for backwards fitted Q iteration with a supported-action maximum. CPU R1 uses a small double-critic IQL MLP and the mode of its advantage-weighted actor. Both RL learners use γ = 1.

R0 and R1 redistribute the audited terminal reward using the accumulated logged posterior means of keeps as a potential, with zero potential at absorption. The final transition subtracts the accumulated potential, preserving each root's total reward. N6 uses the noise-free simulator fork outcomes as training labels. Test estimates use unshaped paired terminal gains. The root audit draws are common across policies and cancel in their paired difference.

The declared engineering floor is a mean gain of 10% of the exact N1-to-DP gap. The benchmark reports each method's test interval and records whether its point estimate clears the floor. It uses the transported P4 baseline and a short horizon.

## Reference and supported results

Exact N1 0.00119991, exact DP 0.00226813, exact gap 0.00106822. The best deterministic static Bayes-keep value for this horizon is 0.00218046. Paired simulation recovered a DP-minus-N1 mean of 0.00101557 over 6000 test roots.

Logged training contained 41961 decisions and 14298 selected fork points. Prefit status was **meets thresholds**.

| Method | Dev-selected configuration | Gain over N1 [95% CI] | DP gap recovered [95% CI] | Gain over short-horizon static [95% CI] | Clears floor |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| N6 | alpha=5 | +0.00094604 [+0.00084566, +0.00104642] | 88.6% [79.2%, 98.0%] | +0.00001564 [-0.00002403, +0.00005531] | yes |
| R0 | leaves=7, rounds=36 | +0.00073121 [+0.00062667, +0.00083575] | 68.5% [58.7%, 78.2%] | -0.00019919 [-0.00026525, -0.00013314] | yes |
| R1 | expectile=0.9, inverse_temperature=16, width=32, critic_steps=3200, actor_steps=1200 | +0.00089924 [+0.00080489, +0.00099359] | 84.2% [75.3%, 93.0%] | -0.00003116 [-0.00005593, -0.00000639] | yes |

## Deliberately removed support

The removal logger skips every eligible E1 and visits no eligible E2. Before fitting, the gate checks both legal arms using P7's cluster counts, stage-action coverage, local decision ESS and known zero propensity. N6 additionally checks for fork labels at each visited stage and cluster. The gate checks each candidate policy before dev evaluation. The unsupported path yields no deployable policy.

| Method | Prefit status | Held-out zero-propensity target rows |
|---|---|---:|
| N6 | insufficient data | 387 |
| R0 | insufficient data | 387 |
| R1 | insufficient data | 387 |

Coverage and performance here concern the specified E-SYN law and logging mixture. Real-loop training support, the logged fork loader and confirmation on fresh audited campaigns have separate gates.

Algorithm references are [Ernst et al.](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v6/ernst05a.html) and [Kostrikov et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.06169).
